text:
Alex Morgan: Reposting follow-ups from the PM: we need owners & deadlines for the remediation items from last night's outage. Please add JIRA links and RACI by EOD.
Nadia Ortiz: I'll take the client-side throttling fix and the regression test addition. I'll open tickets and tag @Jon for rollout review.
Jon Wu: I'll own the load-shedding policy rollback and the canary metrics dashboard. Will create RED-11011 and RED-11012 now.
Nadia Ortiz: Created RED-11013 (client throttling) and RED-11014 (regression test harness). Assigning @Jon reviewer. Links: https://jira.redwood/RED-11013
Jon Wu: Created RED-11011/11012. RED-11011 assigned to me, RED-11012 (dashboard) assigned to @EngOps for visibility.
deploy-bot: Automated: Postmortem record archived -> https://postmortems.redwood/1791
Alex Morgan: Quick RACI proposal for clarity:
- RED-11011: R=Jon, A=Jon, C=Nadia, I=Platform
- RED-11013: R=Nadia, A=Nadia, C=Jon, I=Client SDK
Can you both confirm?
Nadia Ortiz: Confirmed. I'll add acceptance criteria to RED-11013 (latency regression tests + edge cases).
Jon Wu: Confirmed. ETA proposals:
- RED-11011 (rollback analysis) due +2 days
- RED-11012 (canary dashboard) due +5 days
- RED-11013 (throttling fix) due +4 days
- RED-11014 (regression harness) due +7 days
Alex Morgan: Good. Nadia, include a short rollback play in RED-11013 in case the fix causes regressions. Jon, make sure the dashboard includes the 95/99p latency panels and a green/red threshold.
Nadia Ortiz: Will do. I'll comment in the ticket with a runbook snippet and the kill-switch command.
Jon Wu: Putting a note to run the end-to-end canary twice during peak window.
Alex Morgan: I'll check progress in tomorrow's postmortem checkpoints. If any blocker appears, escalate here and update the JIRA. Thanks :thumbsup:
